skills.name: acs-challenge-approach
skills.description: Resolve user-owned decisions one at a time. Use when choices that cannot be discovered from the environment block an idea, plan, design, triage brief, or wayfinder ticket.

skills.name: acs-draw-portfolio-dag
skills.description: Render Markdown workstreams and dependency tickets as an interactive HTML DAG or Mermaid flowchart. Use for portfolio sequencing, frontier visibility, cross-cutting ticket tags, or live progress rendering during an implement run.

skills.name: acs-research
skills.description: Resolve an external technical fact blocking an engineering decision, specification, diagnosis, or implementation, with cited primary evidence. Use for bounded engineering questions unavailable in the repository; learning-oriented synthesis and original research belong to the user's research workflow.

skills.name: acs-review-agent-instructions
skills.description: Review or update a repository's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. Use to encode one incident lesson, repair instruction hierarchy and pointers, prune ineffective guidance, or reconnect shared-context routing; use acs-translate-agent-context for runtime migration.

skills.name: acs-writing-great-skills
skills.description: Author or revise a predictable system skill. Use when defining a skill's invocation boundary, procedure, references, completion criteria, or shared-memory contract.
